verdicts.reason: A reads left to right: product in the centre, then headline, body, CTA and legal stacked neatly on the right. Its flaws are a tiny wordmark floating alone top-left, a sale ribbon detached from the product that bleeds off the left edge, and a lot of dead space in the left third. B squeezes the body copy into a narrow ragged column ending in the orphan 'June 21.', with a stray dot touching it. It also crams the legal text into a tiny five-line column on the right, shrinks the product to an icon in the bottom-left corner, and shrinks the sale ribbon, so the right side feels cramped and the left side empty.
